quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #6
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 19

questions.question: An octagonal sign is always a:

options.text: Speed limit sign.
Stop sign.
Hospital sign.
Railroad warning sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: All octagonal signs are stop signs. You must come to a complete stop at a red, eight-sided sign.

questions.question: When may you proceed through an intersection with a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to check that there is no cross traffic.
After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe to proceed.
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection.
After slowing down to 10 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe to proceed.
questions.explanation: Stop before the stop line or crosswalk at any intersection with a stop sign. If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop before entering the intersection. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: You cannot pass safely on a two-way, two-lane street unless:

options.text: You can clearly see the road ahead.
You can return to your lane before meeting oncoming traffic.
Your vehicle can go fast enough to pass.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Safe passing on a two-way, two-lane street requires three things: you can see the road ahead clearly, you can return to your lane before meeting oncoming traffic, and your vehicle can go fast enough to pass. Never pass where it is illegal or unsafe.

questions.question: If you are driving on a one-way street and an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches, you must:

options.text: Turn on your hazard lights.
Move to the nearest side of the road and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.
Slow down until the vehicle passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the nearest side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches on a one-way street, move to the nearest side of the road and stop.

questions.question: If you need to drive in foggy weather:

options.text: Turn on your low beam headlights.
Turn on your hazard lights.
It is okay to drive at the maximum speed limit.
Do not drive faster than 10 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use your headlights when you cannot see 500 feet ahead. Use low beams in fog or rain. High beams reflect back into your eyes and make it harder to see.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway:

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
Only pass on the right.
Watch for oncoming traffic.
You do not need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear. Use your turn signal to show other drivers you are changing lanes.

questions.question: Before passing another vehicle, you should signal:

options.text: Just before changing lanes.
At any time.
After changing lanes.
Early enough so other drivers know your plans.

questions.correctAnswerText: Early enough so other drivers know your plans.
questions.explanation: Signal early before you pass so other drivers have time to know what you plan to do.

questions.question: When driving on an interstate:

options.text: Stop on the shoulder if you are tired.
Always use cruise control.
Signal, check mirrors, and check blind spots before changing lanes.
Change lanes often.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, check mirrors, and check blind spots before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Always signal, check your mirrors, and check your blind spot before changing lanes on an interstate. Only stop on the shoulder in an emergency. Change lanes as little as possible. Avoid cruise control in heavy traffic or bad weather.

questions.question: You may park or stop on the freeway shoulder:

options.text: If you turn on your emergency flashers.
If no part of your vehicle is on the road.
If you need to check a map.
Only in an emergency.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only in an emergency.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on a freeway shoulder except during an emergency.

questions.question: An "End school zone" sign means:

options.text: The speed limit is 20 mph.
You are entering a reduced speed zone.
There is a higher chance of seeing pedestrians.
The reduced speed zone is ending.

questions.correctAnswerText: The reduced speed zone is ending.
questions.explanation: Follow the school zone speed limit during the posted times. An "End school zone" sign marks where the reduced speed zone ends.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, you should:

options.text: Speed up to get out of the way.
Stop your vehicle and block their path.
Do everything you can to give them a clear path to drive.
Signal to them when it is safe for them to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do everything you can to give them a clear path to drive.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights is near, you must give them a clear path. If it is safe, pull to the side of the road to let them pass.

questions.question: Which statement is true about driving on wet roads?

options.text: The faster you drive, the less grip your tires have.
Good tires are not affected by water.
Deep water is safer than shallow water.
Slowing down makes the road more slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The faster you drive, the less grip your tires have.
questions.explanation: Driving faster on wet roads reduces your tires' ability to remove water. If you drive too fast, your tires lose grip and you may hydroplane, or slide on a layer of water.

questions.question: You should always use your turn signal when:

options.text: Changing lanes.
Pulling into or out of a parking space.
Pulling into traffic from a parking area or alley.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Always use your turn signal whenever you move left or right. Signal when entering traffic from a parking space, changing lanes, or passing another vehicle.

questions.question: When turning left on a multilane, one-way street or highway, you should start from:

options.text: The middle of the intersection.
The right lane.
The left lane.
Any lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane.
questions.explanation: Always start a left turn from the left lane on multilane streets and highways.

questions.question: When driving at night and another vehicle approaches from the opposite direction, your headlights should:

options.text: Be on high beam.
Be on low beam.
Be off. Use parking lights only.
Be on either high or low beam.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be on low beam.
questions.explanation: Do not use high beam headlights when another vehicle is coming toward you or when you are following another vehicle. Use low beam to keep everyone safe.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
Only certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Do not enter.
Both lanes must merge smoothly together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are for buses and cars with the driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: Highway signs that warn drivers about dangerous conditions are called:

options.text: Regulatory signs.
Warning signs.
Information signs.
Guide signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning signs.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to possible dangers ahead. Follow warning signs for your safety. Ignoring them could cause an accident.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.
Construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road will make a sharp right turn, then a sharp left turn.

questions.question: How alcohol affects your reflexes and judgment depends on:

options.text: Whether you drink beer instead of wine.
Whether you drink wine instead of beer.
Whether you drink ciders or mixed drinks.
How much alcohol is in your blood.

questions.correctAnswerText: How much alcohol is in your blood.
questions.explanation: Any type of alcohol can harm your reflexes and judgment. The type of drink does not matter. Only the amount of alcohol in your blood affects your driving ability.

questions.question: Which of these drugs can affect your ability to drive?

options.text: Allergy medicine
Marijuana
Cold medicine
All of these

questions.correctAnswerText: All of these
questions.explanation: Many types of drugs can affect your driving. This includes illegal drugs and legal medicines you can buy or get by prescription. Driving while impaired by any drug is illegal.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, what must you do?

options.text: Slow down and stay in your lane.
Keep driving in your lane.
Move to the right side and stop.
Stop right where you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right side and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights or hear a siren, pull to the right side of the road and stop immediately.

questions.question: What happens when you take drugs and alcohol together?

options.text: It increases your chance of crashing.
It is no more dangerous than alcohol alone.
It makes alcohol's effects weaker.
It does not affect your driving ability.

questions.correctAnswerText: It increases your chance of crashing.
questions.explanation: Drugs—including illegal drugs, prescription drugs, and over-the-counter medicines—can damage your brain function and hurt your driving. Mixing drugs with alcohol makes crashing much more likely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must turn left.
No left turn.
No U-turn.
Truck route to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What problems can worn or bald tires cause?

options.text: They make turning harder.
They are more likely to hydroplane.
They increase your stopping distance.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Worn or bald tires make turning harder, increase your stopping distance, and cause hydroplaning more easily because there is not enough tread.

questions.question: Is drinking alcohol and driving a safety problem?

options.text: It is a minor problem.
It is a serious problem.
It is safe if you only have a few drinks.
It is only dangerous to the driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is a serious problem.
questions.explanation: Drinking alcohol and driving is a serious safety problem. You cannot drive safely after drinking. It endangers both you and everyone else on the road.
